result.summary: Added command support for JMAK over TCP (data channel) and SMS (text channel). New JmakProtocolEncoder (constructor (Protocol, boolean textChannel)) encodes the listed commands in both formats and is registered in JmakProtocol for both. Added a TYPE_ALARM_MOVEMENT command constant because no existing type covers movement alarm. New encoder tests cover every command on both channels, including the three spec examples. The full suite passes: 612 tests, 0 failures, 0 errors, 27 skipped; checkstyleMain and checkstyleTest pass. Nothing was committed or pushed.

changes.summary: New encoder extending StringProtocolEncoder. Builds '$id;value;|...#' for TCP and 'JMAK#s|e;id;value#...' for SMS. Maps engine stop/resume, output control (index 1/2/3 to params 34/94/167), periodic positions (param 2), set odometer (30), set connection (IP to 13, domain to 43, then port 12), reboot (93=1 over TCP, literal JMAK#REBOOT# over SMS), speed limit (16 enabled, then 17), low battery (57), power removal (55) and movement (59).
Declares supported data and text commands, sets the SMS text encoder, and adds StringEncoder plus the JmakProtocolEncoder (TCP mode) to the server pipeline before the decoder.

New tests: testEncodeDataChannel and testEncodeTextChannel, covering every supported command on both channels, including the spec examples $43;jmak.com.br;|12;5259;#, JMAK#s;13;191.233.246.121#s;12;5259# and JMAK#e;57;0#.

acceptance.criterion: Commands are encoded as specified over TCP
Commands are encoded as specified over SMS
acceptance.evidence: JmakProtocolEncoderTest.testEncodeTextChannel asserts JMAK#s;34;1#, JMAK#s;13;191.233.246.121#s;12;5259#, JMAK#e;57;0#, JMAK#REBOOT#, JMAK#e;16;1#s;17;80#, JMAK#e;59;1# and the rest. All pass.
New JmakProtocolEncoderTest with 2 test methods; both pass in the gradle test run (tests=2, failures=0, errors=0).
./gradlew --offline test checkstyleMain checkstyleTest with JDK 21: :test executed, 428 result files, 612 tests, 0 failures, 0 errors, 27 skipped. Checkstyle passes after one LineLength fix.

acceptance.criterion: Encoder class and registration match the spec
acceptance.evidence: JmakProtocolEncoder extends StringProtocolEncoder with constructor (Protocol protocol, boolean textChannel). JmakProtocol calls setTextCommandEncoder(new JmakProtocolEncoder(this, true)) and adds new JmakProtocolEncoder(JmakProtocol.this, false) to the TCP pipeline.

human_needed.question: Is 'power removal alarm' the existing Traccar alarmRemove command (TYPE_ALARM_REMOVE), which I mapped to event 55?
human_needed.why: Traccar has no dedicated power-removal command type. I picked alarmRemove as the closest match, which is an assumption.

human_needed.question: Should the odometer and overspeed limit values be sent exactly as given in the command data, with no unit conversion?
human_needed.why: The spec does not say which unit the device expects. I send the raw data value, which is what the decoder's km-to-metres conversion suggests but does not prove.

human_needed.question: Should 'alarmMovement' get a label in the web UI command list?
human_needed.why: I added a new command type constant. Traccar's web translations were not checked for a matching key, so a label may be missing in the UI.

harness_used: Read/Grep/Glob to inspect JmakProtocol, JmakProtocolDecoder, existing encoders (Wondex, Adm, Gator, Ruptela) and ProtocolTest helpers
Gradle wrapper (./gradlew --offline test checkstyleMain checkstyleTest) for compile, unit tests and checkstyle

harness_gaps.problem: The default java on this machine is 17, but the build targets Java 21 (build.gradle). The build only worked after pointing JAVA_HOME at /opt/homebrew/opt/openjdk@21. Documenting the JDK 21 requirement would help.
No command type exists for movement alarm or power removal alarm, so the mapping to alarmRemove and the new alarmMovement constant were judgment calls.
No repository agent files or special harness instructions were present beyond the global CLAUDE.md writing rules, so nothing repo-specific guided the work.
